import openpyxl, os
out=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
data=wb['Data']
yearmap={}
for col in range(1, data.max_column+1):
    y=data.cell(row=4, column=col).value
    if isinstance(y,(int,float)):
        v=data.cell(row=14, column=col+1).value
        yearmap[int(y)]=v
lookup=wb['Lookup']
# A2=2007, A3=2008, A4='=A3+1' -> 2009, etc.
# So row r corresponds to year 2007 + (r-2)
for r in range(2,13):
    yr = 2007 + (r - 2)
    if yr in yearmap:
        lookup.cell(row=r, column=2).value=yearmap[yr]
    else:
        lookup.cell(row=r, column=2).value=''
wb.save(out)
print('done', yearmap)
